body.x: PUBL Studio(www.publ-studio.com) will showcase ebooks and game-learning(G-learning) contents at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show in Las vegas, U.S. held from January 7th to 10th.

The appbooks; Angry Bird, Little Detective K, Picture Book, Brain Puzzle, MapleStory will be introduced at the show, which connect to a new concept of education contents. For example, Detective K is a learning appbook combined with the Game of interesting story and reasoning. Children can solve the problem with the feeling as if they were detective while playing, which is the biggest feature of the apps.

PUBL Studio develops a lot of interactive appbooks for Kids in contract with 'Rovio' of the globally Angry Birds franchise, Nexon 'MapleStory' and 'Highlights' learning book company in US, etc. Those contracts even made the company to be known global-wide. It holds about 1,000 contents and builds new paradigm of education based on the education system connected to games.

"At the show, we plan to have a meeting for launching strategy towards American market. And we also prepare the meeting with game companies including Blizzard, and will finalize the contract with Highlights. Also, we expect to introduce ourself to the new companies for getting up a plan of International Book fair in Bologna in April." said the officials.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases more than 3,200 exhibitors, including manufacturers, developers and suppliers of consumer technology hardware, content, technology delivery systems and more; a conference and more than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries. The first CES took place in New York City in June of 1967. Since then, thousands of products have been announced at the yearly show in January.
